notes.title: MATCHO is a unique first-person shooter with match-3 mechanics
notes.notes:
First-person shooting and match-3 together? MATCHO sure does sound strange but it also looks like it could be tons of fun and it's coming to Linux.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2022/06/matcho-is-a-unique-first-person-shooter-with-match-3-mechanics

notes.title: This FPS is basically Bejeweled with guns (and it has a story)
notes.notes: lien invasion! First-person combat! Wallrunning! Drama! Match-3 gameplay! One of these things, as Sesame Street taught us, is not like the others, but they all come together in a single, kind of weird-looking package called Matcho, a "match-3 FPS" coming to Steam later this year... Read more.
